item.title: Flock Cameras: Public Safety Tool or Warrantless Surveillance Machine?
item.description: An independent analysis of Flock Safety ALPR cameras: how they actually work, what data they collect beyond license plates, how data sharing creates a shadow national database, and why the warrant question is the real issue.
